problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$D=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 6 & 5 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}].$

feedback.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${a}_{13}$,  we remove the $1$st row and the $3$rd column:

$$
A=|\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 1 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & 2 & ∗ & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & ∗ & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & ∗ & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & ∗ & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{13}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${a}_{13}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{13} & =(-1)^{1+3}{M}_{13} \\  & ={M}_{13} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
